Finishing.name: Float Game
Finishing.description: Increases success rate of floaters and runners in the paint.

Finishing.name: Layup Mixmaster
Finishing.description: Improves ability to complete advanced/acrobatic layups (euros, reverses, etc.).

Finishing.name: Posterizer
Finishing.description: Raises chances of dunking on defenders with contact dunks.

Playmaking.name: Versatile Visionary
Playmaking.description: Improves passing accuracy and effectiveness of advanced passes

Playmaking.name: Break Starter
Playmaking.description: Improves accuracy and distance of outlet passes after rebounds

Playmaking.name: Dimer
Playmaking.description: Boosts teammate shot success after receiving a pass

Playmaking.name: Handles for Days
Playmaking.description: Reduces stamina drain when chaining dribble moves

Playmaking.name: Ankle Assassin
Playmaking.description: Increases chances of breaking defenders with dribble moves (consistent with 2K26 dribble system)

Playmaking.name: Strong Handles
Playmaking.description: Improves ability to maintain control when dribbling through contact

Playmaking.name: Lightning Launch
Playmaking.description: Provides a faster and more explosive first step out of triple threat or dribble.

Defense.name: Off-Ball Pest
Defense.description: Improves defense against off-ball movement and cuts

Defense.name: Pick Dodger
Defense.description: Helps avoid or fight through screens

Defense.name: On-Ball Menace
Defense.description: Improves ability to stay in front of ball handlers

Off-Ball.name: Slippery Off-Ball
Off-Ball.description: Improves ability to get open and move effectively without the ball
